title: GoQSystem order-management service reports third-party access that took order data of 4,367,390 individuals
date_note: Date is GoQSystem's first announcement (12 November); added now because notices continued to 19 November.
geo_basis: country (Tokyo); the notices read do not state the company's address
summary: GoQSystem said on 12 November that a third party accessed its system on 10 and 11 November and took out part of its order data, including names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses and order contents. Its 13 November second report gives the figures currently known as 1,694 store companies, 4,984,595 orders and 4,367,390 individuals. It says a vulnerability in an inquiry form was exploited and that it holds no credit card data.
plain: A Japanese online-store order system says an outsider took customer order data, including names, addresses and phone numbers, from stores that use it. It says no credit card data was held.
exec: If your online store uses GoQSystem, its customers' contact and order data may be exposed and stores must notify them.
action: Stores using GoQSystem: follow GoQ's notices, report jointly to the Personal Information Protection Commission and warn customers about suspicious emails, SMS and calls.
impact: Figures currently known per GoQSystem (13 November): 1,694 store companies, 4,984,595 orders, 4,367,390 individuals.

sources.name: GoQSystem third report, 16 Nov (joint report to the PPC)

validation.note: Company's own two notices read in full; piyolog compiles later notices.

review.note: Figures, dates, cause, data items match notices 1-2; joint PPC report in the action comes from the 16 Nov third notice, which was not cited; added it as a source
